A palpable moment of expectant eye contact and elegant off-axis body language. Photographic editorial film still, shallow focus but map icon story details legible. Preserve her recognizable identity above stylistic exaggeration.
No viewer hands, arms or legs; no added characters; no exposed cleavage or changed neckline; no blood, new props, door, portal, text, logo, watermark, UI, borders or montage.
